visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black t-shirt sits inside an open-sided tent, holding up a dark camouflage sleeping bag. He demonstrates a built-in mesh mosquito net over his head while pointing at it with his gloved-like watch hand. The background shows a beige quilted mat and outdoor foliage. (2) The scene cuts to the man holding a black compression sack with a visible gold-colored brand logo. He gestures towards the sack with his left hand. The lighting is bright and natural. (3) The man displays the sleeping bag's fabric close-up, rubbing the dark camouflage material to show its texture. A large watch is visible on his left wrist. (4) He demonstrates the integrated mosquito net again, pulling a zipper along the top edge of the bag. He places the mesh over his face to show how it functions. (5) The man handles the compression sack, highlighting the various tightening straps around its circumference. He maintains a neutral yet engaged facial expression. (6) A fast-paced, speed-ramped sequence shows the man on his knees, rolling and stuffing the bulky sleeping bag into the black compression sack on the quilted floor mat. (7) The final phase shows the man kneeling and holding the fully packed and compressed sack, presenting the finished result to the camera.
